analysis.title: Mastercard Inc. (MA): 3Q26 Key Takeaways: Solid quarter with bull case remaining intact
key_insights: GS keeps a Buy on MA after 3Q26 and says the core bull case is intact. It expects easier comparisons against specific client losses and other headwinds to support a reacceleration in growth and a return of the multiple toward historical levels.
GS cites a reacceleration in the U.S. with the company pointing to recent client wins. It expects this to continue as the Capital One migration laps over the next 2 quarters.
MA trades at a discount to its own history and at parity with Visa, which GS says leaves room for multiple expansion over the next year.

3Q26 total net revenue was $9.807bn versus Visible Alpha consensus of $9.670bn, up 14% y/y in constant currency. Payment Network net revenue was $5.749bn (consensus $5.650bn). Value-added Services and Solutions net revenue was $4.058bn (consensus $4.025bn).
3Q26 adjusted operating income was $5.936bn, a 60.5% margin, versus consensus of $5.815bn and 60.1%. Adjusted EPS was $5.31 versus consensus of $5.17.
Total GPV was $2.483tn, up 8% y/y (9% constant currency) and 1% below consensus. Credit GPV was $1.311tn (+7% y/y) and debit GPV was $1.172tn (+10% y/y).
Cross-Border Assessments revenue was $3.841bn, 1% above consensus, on 11% constant-currency cross-border volume growth. Switched transactions grew 9% y/y.

4Q26 guidance: constant-currency net revenue growth at the high end of low double digits, with a ~1% FX headwind, so reported non-GAAP growth is also at the high end of low double digits. Non-GAAP opex is guided to grow low teens reported. GS says this implies roughly $5.56bn-$5.61bn of non-GAAP operating income.

GS raises its 12-month price target to $743 from $716, based on ~28x (unchanged) its Q5-Q8 EPS estimates. Its 2026/27/28 EPS estimates move slightly lower, to $20.05/$23.53/$28.14 from $20.10/$23.77/$28.34.

market_movers.rationale: GS raised the target from $716 on a ~28x multiple of Q5-Q8 EPS. It says the bull case is intact, with growth set to reaccelerate as client-loss comparisons ease. Stock at $610.31, 21.7% upside.
